source: 18. Should every request retrieve a fixed number of passages? How do active, adaptive, and corrective ZXNAME0000XZ approaches change that assumption? [Advanced] Fixed ’retrieve top-k once for every request’ is only one ZXNAME0001XZ policy. FLARE retrieves during long-form generation when upcoming content appears uncertain. Self-ZXNAME0002XZ trains a model to emit reflection signals that control when to retrieve and how to critique retrieved evidence and generations. CRAG adds a retrieval evaluator and chooses corrective actions when retrieved documents appear weak, including knowledge refinement and, in the paper’s setup, external web search. These are different methods, but they share a principle: retrieval can be conditional and feedback-driven. The trade-off is complexity. A gating model can make its own mistakes, iterative retrieval adds latency, and web fallback changes the trust and freshness model. Use adaptive retrieval when the cost of retrieving everything is high or when tasks vary substantially in knowledge needs; do not assume a named method transfers unchanged to every system. [13][14][15]
zh: 18. 每个请求都应该检索固定数量的段落吗？主动、适应性和纠正性 ZXNAME0000XZ 方法如何改变这一假设？ [高级] 修复了“每个请求检索一次 top-k”仅为一个 ZXNAME0001XZ 策略的问题。当即将出现的内容显得不确定时，FLARE 在长格式生成期间进行检索。 Self-ZXNAME0002XZ 训练模型发出反射信号，控制何时检索以及如何批评检索到的证据和生成。 CRAG 添加了一个检索评估器，并在检索到的文档显得薄弱时选择纠正措施，包括知识精炼以及本文设置中的外部网络搜索。这些是不同的方法，但它们有一个共同的原则：检索可以是有条件的和反馈驱动的。权衡是复杂性。门控模型可能会犯错误，迭代检索会增加延迟，而网络回退会改变信任和新鲜度模型。当检索所有内容的成本很高或任务的知识需求差异很大时，请使用自适应检索；不要假设命名方法会原封不动地传输到每个系统。 [13][14][15]
